name: doc-generate
description: Generate or update API documentation from code annotations (JSDoc, TypeScript types, OpenAPI specs). Produces structured documentation in Markdown or OpenAPI format.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Source directory to document. Default: src/api/.

outputs.name: docs
outputs.description: Generated documentation in the requested format.

failureConditions.signal: source directory is empty or doesn't exist

failureConditions.description: No JSDoc or type annotations found
failureConditions.signal: no export declarations with JSDoc found
